summary: Mobile View: Core OK / Not OK Buttons Not Visible for Technicians
reported_issue: In the mobile viewport, technicians cannot mark a picked core part as OK or Not OK because those buttons do not appear (they work on desktop). Repro: mobile browser, open a WO, request a part with a core, pick it, observe the picked-part options.
expected_after_fix: The mobile UI should display the OK / Not OK options for a picked core the same way desktop does.
steps_i_followed: Located WO S9-24075 which has a picked core part ('Core for 3.50-3.82\" (89-97mm) SPRING LOADED T-BOLT CLAMP') in the awaiting-OK/Not-OK inspection state (confirmed OK/Not OK controls present on desktop).
Loaded the WO Lines page in a mobile viewport (390x844, isMobile + touch, iPhone UA).
Expanded the line containing the core part (standard mobile drill-in).
Checked for the OK / Not OK core buttons and verified their visibility (isVisible + bounding box) and captured a screenshot.
actual_now: The OK / Not OK core buttons ARE present and visible in the mobile viewport. After expanding the line, the core row 'Core for 3.50-3.82\" (89-97mm) SPRING LOADED T-BOLT CLAMP' (Qty 3) shows a green 'Ok' button and a red 'Not Ok' button, both rendered and visible (isVisible=true, non-zero bounding boxes ~45x24px). This matches desktop behavior and expected_after_fix.
notes: Re-test of prior NEEDS-INFO. Found an existing WO with a picked core awaiting inspection and confirmed the OK/Not OK buttons now render in the mobile layout (screenshot shows both buttons on the core row). Bug does not reproduce.
